```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r, USDA swine data}
clean_counties <- function(year) {
  read_csv(str_c("data/raw/swine-counties/counties_", year, ".csv"), show_col_types = F) |> 
    select(county_ID = FIPS,
           county = NAME,
           state = STATE_NAME) |> 
    mutate(swine = TRUE, year = year) |> 
    unique()
}

combined_counties <- list_rbind(map(2020:2025, clean_counties)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = swine,
              names_prefix = "swine_") |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~if_else(is.na(.x), FALSE, .x)))

write_csv(combined_counties, "data/clean/combined_counties.csv")

```

```{r county climate data}
read_climate <- function(variable) {
  read_csv(str_c("data/raw/", variable, ".csv"), show_col_types = F) |>
    mutate(county = str_remove(Name, "County"),
           state = State,
           ID3 = str_sub(ID, -3, -1)) |> 
    select(ID, ID3, county, state, all_of(variable))
}

climate <- read_climate("temp2125") |> 
  left_join(read_climate("dailymin2125")) |> 
  left_join(read_climate("dailymax2125")) |> 
  left_join(read_climate("precip2125"))

write_csv(climate, "data/clean/climate_county.csv")
```

```{r crop data by counties}
read_crops <- function(crop) {
  read_csv(str_c("data/raw/", crop, ".csv"), show_col_types = F) |> 
    filter(Period == "YEAR", County != "OTHER COUNTIES") |> 
    select(year = Year, state = State, county = County,
           stateID = `State ANSI`, countyID = `County ANSI`,
           `Data Item`, Value) |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Data Item`, values_from = Value)
}
  
wheat <- read_crops("wheat") |> 
  select(year, state, county, stateID, countyID, contains("PRODUCTION")) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x))) |> 
  mutate(wheat = `WHEAT, SPRING, DURUM - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU` + 
           `WHEAT, WINTER - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU` +
           `WHEAT, SPRING, (EXCL DURUM) - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU`) |> 
  select(year, state, county, stateID, countyID, wheat)

soy <- read_crops("soybean") |> 
  select(year, state, county, stateID, countyID, soybean = `SOYBEANS - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU`)

corn <- read_crops("corn") |> 
  select(year, state, county, stateID, countyID, corn = `CORN, GRAIN - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU`)

crop_production <- wheat |> 
  full_join(corn, by = join_by(year, state, county, stateID, countyID)) |> 
  full_join(soy, by = join_by(year, state, county, stateID, countyID)) |> 
  mutate(fullID = str_c(stateID, countyID)) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x)))

write_csv(crop_production, "data/clean/crop_production.csv")
```
